decisive_spans.text: 4-week history of dry cough and mild weight loss
multifocal consolidations in the right upper lobe extending to the right lower lobe

response.rationale: D9 (Lung Cancer) is supported by the patient's age, persistent cough, weight loss, and multifocal consolidations on CT. D4 (Cryptogenic organizing pneumonia) is also supported by the cough and air-space opacity, but the multifocal consolidations and weight loss lean more towards D9. The negative infectious workup makes D9 more likely than D4, which is often a diagnosis of exclusion after infection is ruled out.
